visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with long black hair, a black beret, and glasses stands with their back to the camera near a riverside with swan boats. They turn around to smile at the camera, wearing a white t-shirt over a grey long-sleeve. (2) The scene shifts to the person walking through a bright green park; they turn and smile frequently, exhibiting exaggerated cheerful expressions while gesturing with their hands. (3) The character sits on a stone wall overlooking a body of water with a city skyline in the distance, looking contemplative under bright natural daylight. (4) The person is seen crouching in tall grass, interacting with the plants, then lying down on the grass while looking up at the sky with a joyful smile. (5) Running through the park, the person holds the hand of an unseen companion (only an arm is visible), looking back with excitement and a wide grin. (6) The character interacts with yellow flat-cutout figures of a couple in a proposal pose, pointing and making comedic faces. (7) The setting changes to an urban road with a large cable-stayed bridge; the person is shown crouching and pretending to cry, wiping their eyes with exaggerated sorrow. (8) Returning to the park, the person performs intensely, lying and crawling on the grass while singing with high facial arousal and strained expressions as the sun sets in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male vocal track begins singing a rhythmic pop melody in Mandarin accompanied by a gentle acoustic guitar. The voice is clean, earnest, and well-enunciated with a moderate conversational volume. (2) As the track progresses, the intensity of the vocals increases slightly; the speaker maintains a steady singing pace with rising intonations matching the melodic phrasing of the song. (3) The vocal delivery becomes more emotional and expressive, utilizing breathiness and subtle strain for dramatic effect, while the guitar and percussion maintain a consistent mid-tempo beat. (4) The final segment features a sudden shift to high-arousal, aggressive rock-style singing with shouted Hokkien lyrics. The spectral brightness increases as the voice reaches a higher pitch and volume, accompanied by more prominent electronic elements and drums.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Emotional Escalation -> Comedic Climax
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a creative and humorous Mandarin/Hokkien language parody cover of Billie Eilish's 'BIRDS OF A FEATHER'. It uses an 'amateur music video' aesthetic, combining earnest acting in scenic locations with a sudden, chaotic shift to an intense, shout-singing rock finale to generate comedic contrast and viral appeal.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The contrast between the soft pop aesthetic of the first half and the aggressive, high-energy rock ending is the primary comedic driver.
